description: This interface defines a listener for global property events such as creation, update, or deletion within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: GlobalPropertyListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to global property lifecycle events (creation, update, deletion).

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Determines if the listener is interested in notifications for a specific property name.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a global property is created or updated.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles the event when a global property is deleted.
